notes: MAJOR IMPROVEMENT: with_skill pass rate jumped from 0.71 (iteration 1) to 1.00 (iteration 2). All 7 assertions now pass for all 3 evals.
The critical 'gaps-identified' assertion now passes 100% for with_skill (was 0% in iteration 1). The skill no longer rubber-stamps plans as 100% complete.
Coverage scores are well-calibrated: 82, 88, 90 — reflecting genuine gap detection with scores under 100.
'auto-patch-present' also now passes 100% (was 0% in iteration 1), with concrete [ADDED] and [EXPANDED] sections.
Format assertions continue to pass 100% for with_skill. Without-skill baselines unchanged at 0.52 average.
Time cost: with_skill is now slower (132s vs 106s average, +26s). The stress-test gap categories add analysis time. Token usage also up (+5277 tokens).
The gap between with_skill (1.00) and without_skill (0.52) is now +0.48, up from +0.19 in iteration 1. The skill provides substantial value over baseline.
